prompt: The fact checker did not pass these claims. Fix each one: change the sentence so its quotes say everything it says, or pick quotes that do. Leave a claim out to

content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"The pumpkin seed oil exceeds acceptable peroxide value thresholds between three and five months after bottling.","sources":[{"id":"C061-CH1","field":"detail","quote":"hits a peroxide value above the acceptable threshold somewhere between three and five months after bottling"}]},{"claim":2,"text":"The company does not have gas chromatography, fatty acid profiling, or tocopherol analysis capabilities.","sources":[{"id":"C061-CH1","field":"detail","quote":"We do not have gas chromatography equipment and we have never done a fatty acid profile breakdown or a tocopherol content analysis in-house"}]},{"claim":3,"text":"The company intends to enter the German organic retail segment within two years by adding a dedicated organic cold-press line.","sources":[{"id":"C061","field":"plans","quote":"dedicated cold-press line for organic seeds, physically separated from the conventional line, to simplify certification compliance and expand the organic export range"}]}]}
